title: "stopBranch called more than once by remote on" exception crashing Bazel

body:
### Description of the bug:


We are somewhat frequently seeing error messages like :
```00:01:03.956   126 FATAL: bazel crashed due to an internal error. Printing stack trace:
00:01:03.956   127 java.lang.AssertionError: stopBranch called more than once by remote on external/rules_jvm_external+/private/tools/java/com/github/bazelbuild/rules_jvm_external/zip/libzip.jar
00:01:03.956   128 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.dynamic.DynamicSpawnStrategy.stopBranch(DynamicSpawnStrategy.java:623)
00:01:03.956   129 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.dynamic.RemoteBranch.lambda$callImpl$1(RemoteBranch.java:160)
00:01:03.956   130 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.exec.AbstractSpawnStrategy$SpawnExecutionContextImpl.lockOutputFiles(AbstractSpawnStrategy.java:363)
00:01:03.956   131 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.exec.local.LocalSpawnRunner.exec(LocalSpawnRunner.java:164)
00:01:03.956   132 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.remote.RemoteSpawnRunner.execLocally(RemoteSpawnRunner.java:563)
00:01:03.956   133 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.remote.RemoteSpawnRunner.execLocallyAndUpload(RemoteSpawnRunner.java:710)

00:01:03.956   135 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.remote.RemoteSpawnRunner.exec(RemoteSpawnRunner.java:249)
00:01:03.956   136 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.exec.AbstractSpawnStrategy.exec(AbstractSpawnStrategy.java:161)
00:01:03.956   137 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.dynamic.RemoteBranch.runRemotely(RemoteBranch.java:89)
00:01:03.956   138 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.dynamic.RemoteBranch.callImpl(RemoteBranch.java:153)
00:01:03.956   139 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.dynamic.Branch.call(Branch.java:188)
00:01:03.956   140 	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.dynamic.Branch.call(Branch.java:43)
00:01:03.956   141 	at com.google.common.util.concurrent.TrustedListenableFutureTask$TrustedFutureInterruptibleTask.runInterruptibly(TrustedListenableFutureTask.java:128)

00:01:03.956   143 	at com.google.common.util.concurrent.TrustedListenableFutureTask.run(TrustedListenableFutureTask.java:80)
00:01:03.956   144 	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(Unknown Source)
00:01:03.956   145 	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(Unknown Source)
00:01:03.956   146 	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Unknown Source)
```

We've seen this error with the same stack trace, other than a differing file ~50 times in the last month.
The files listed that stopBranch was called more than once by remote on are most frequently build tools, persistent worker executables, frequently used external jars, and compiler binaries. A few other example files it's hit on are `cake/closure_compiler.jar`, `external/rules_scala_annex+/third_party/bazel/src/java_tools/buildjar/java/com/google/devtools/build/buildjar/jarhelper/libjarhelper.jar`, and `cake/build/css/less_worker.js` if that's helpful at all.

We suspect that this might have something to do with dynamic spawn strategy, but are unsure. We are using buildfarm as our remote execution software.

### Which category does this issue belong to?

Remote Execution

### What's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.


I spent some time trying to make a minimal example for reproduction, but was unable to reproduce outside of our CI. I'll keep working on this, and will update if I make any headway. 

### Which operating system are you running Bazel on?


Ubuntu 24.04.3
